entities.label: Docs
fields: the signed-in person who owns it (required)
status: one of draft, submitted, approved or rejected (required) (starts as draft)

because: Nobody can see docs any other way.
rules: Signed-in people can see a doc when its author is them.
Signed-in people can see a doc when its reviewer is them and its status is not draft.

rules: Signed-in people can create a doc when its author is them and its status is draft.
Signed-in people can change a doc when its author is them and its status is draft. After the change, its author is them and its status is draft or submitted.
Signed-in people can change a doc when its reviewer is them and its status is submitted. After the change, its reviewer is them and its status is approved or rejected.
Signed-in people can delete a doc when its author is them and its status is draft.

signing_in: People sign in with email (a password or an emailed link).
People confirm their email address before they can sign in.
before_going_live: Set up your own email sender (SMTP). Supabase's built-in sender is for testing and only sends a few emails an hour.
Set your app's real web address in Supabase, for sign-in links and the page people return to after signing in.
